title: MySqlConnector
description: A fully managed ADO.NET connector for MySQL and MariaDB databases.

data.text: MySqlConnector is a fast, fully managed ADO.NET connector for MySQL and MariaDB. It is a drop-in replacement for Oracle's MySQL Connector/NET with improved performance and async support.

data.title: Connecting and Querying
data.content: Connect to MySQL and execute a query.

terms.definition: A high-performance ADO.NET driver for MySQL and MariaDB.
A community-developed fork of MySQL, fully compatible with MySQL Connectors.

data.title: Note
data.text: MySqlConnector supports async/await natively and is generally faster than the official Oracle connector.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: MySqlConnector is a high-performance MySQL provider
data.takeaway: Use MySqlConnector for reliable MySQL/MariaDB connectivity in .NET.
